requirements.criterion: Each pot value weighs half the next-lower one within a tier (FR-8 literal matrix): 3=1, 6=1/2, 12=1/4, 24=1/8, 48=1/16, 96=1/32

tests.title: [P0] potWeights literal halving matrix equals FR-8 exactly (AC 1)
[P1] normalized weights are strictly decreasing and halve per step, tiers 1..8 (AC 3)
[P1] weights.ts purity: keys off spawnConfig, re-exported via core/index.ts, no UI imports (AC 1, 3)

requirements.criterion: Pot weights normalized per tier so the pot always sums to 20% of total spawn weight (POT_WEIGHT = 0.2), verified with epsilon tolerance

tests.title: [P0] normalizeTo(POT_WEIGHT, potWeights(pot)) sums to 0.2 within 1e-9 for pot lengths 1..6 (AC 2)
[P0] normalizeTo returns a fresh array and never mutates input (AC 2)
[P1] defensive guard: normalizeTo returns all-zero weights for non-positive totals (N1)
distribution sum is 1.0 within epsilon (coupling invariant)
statistical sampling: weightedValue frequencies match 40/40/20 within +/-2% (drift tripwire)

requirements.criterion: Weights are monotonic - a higher value never weighs more than a lower one (strictly decreasing within a tier)

tests.title: [P1] normalized weights are strictly decreasing and halve per step, tiers 1..8 (AC 3)
[P1] weights.ts purity: keys off spawnConfig, re-exported via core/index.ts, no UI imports (AC 1, 3)

requirements.criterion: Combined distribution (fixed 40/40 + normalized pot) picked by a weightedPicker that always re-normalizes and never trusts its input to sum exactly (N1 float rule)

tests.title: [P0] weightedPicker re-normalizes: [1,0.5] and [2/3,1/3] select index 0 with the same probability (AC 4, N1)
[P0] weightedPicker boundary rolls: 2/3+1e-6 -> index 1, 2/3-1e-6 -> index 0, 0.99 -> last index (AC 4)
[P0] weightedPicker consumes exactly one rng draw per call, including pot length 1 edge (RNG contract)
[P1] defensive guard: weightedPicker returns the last index (never undefined) for non-positive totals and non-finite rolls (N1)
[P0] weightedValue wiring resolves pot values by tier (halving-decay pick verified)
[P0] draw-count pin: tier 0 consumes one roll, tier >= 1 consumes two
[P0] draw-count pin: tier >= 1 with roll inside the fixed band consumes one roll
weightedValue respects 40/40/20 distribution (boundary assertions unchanged)
